summary: Integrate a fixed straight chord through concentric piecewise-homogeneous absorbing shells and accumulate optical depth with Beer–Lambert attenuation, excluding refraction, scattering and weather.
objective: Integrate a fixed straight chord through concentric piecewise-homogeneous absorbing shells and accumulate optical depth with Beer–Lambert attenuation, excluding refraction, scattering and weather.
example_prompts: Build an absorption-only straight chord through finite homogeneous atmospheric shells with explicit inverse-metre coefficients and optical-depth checks.

entities.name: Concentric layers
entities.guidance: Define finite increasing radii, layer absorption coefficient beta>=0 in inverse metres and no gaps/overlap.

entities.name: Ray chord
entities.guidance: Intersect a normalized ray with shell boundaries and sort nonnegative entry/exit distances.

entities.name: Optical-depth ledger
entities.guidance: For each traversed segment show ds, beta*ds, cumulative tau and I/I0=exp(-tau).

state_contract.model: Planet radius R>0 and 1..32 outer shell radii are finite strictly increasing metres; each shell is a piecewise-homogeneous isotropic absorbing slab along a ray x(t)=o+t*d with finite origin satisfying ||o||>=R (reject inside-solid origins), normalized direction ||d||=1 and forward parameter t>=0. Require monochromatic beta>=0 in inverse metres. Sort forward sphere intersections, clip traversal at the first solid-planet boundary R (an origin on R directed inward stops immediately), never continue through ground, and compute ds>=0, tau=sum(beta*ds), mathematical T=exp(-tau)>0. A floating-point result T=0 is allowed only with an explicit underflow marker and log-transmittance -tau retained; terminate on nonfinite arithmetic or no atmospheric segment.
state_contract.authority: Finite metre radii, inverse-metre beta values and the normalized forward ray own intersections, segment lengths and optical depth. Blender shell thickness/opacity is context only; Three.js computes clipped forward segments, retains -tau through transmittance underflow and resets the exact ray/layer ledger.

invariants: Segment lengths are never inferred from visual thickness/exaggeration.
tau is nondecreasing for beta>=0; mathematical transmittance lies in (0,1], while a floating-point zero must be labeled underflow and retain finite log-transmittance -tau.
Display gain never alters tau or I/I0.
motion_guidance: Playback follows stored model/data time; reverse scrub is history and display interpolation never changes the numeric model.
creative_affordances: Use scale-separated context, glyphs and trails while disclosing exaggeration and keeping uncertainty visible.
known_limits: No forecast, dataset execution, numerical solve, render or runtime validation was performed.

claims.statement: IUPAC defines Beer–Lambert absorbance for collimated monochromatic radiation in a homogeneous isotropic medium as proportional to absorption path length and concentration, with transmitted radiant power exponentially reduced in its decadic form.
claims.scope: Absorption-only homogeneous-layer application; atmospheric scattering, refraction, emission and broadband effects are excluded.

object_craft.structure: Blender authors a planet solid, named shell boundaries and section frame with clearly labeled altitude exaggeration; glTF exports static context only and never supplies numeric chord length.
object_craft.material: Transparent shells use distinct hatch/order cues; visual opacity is not numeric transmittance.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js normalizes d, solves forward sphere intersections, clips at solid ground, builds segment tubes from numeric endpoints, accumulates tau/log-transmittance, labels underflow and resets.

physical_contract.scope: Static straight-chord integration through absorption-only slabs; no refraction, scattering, emission, broadband transfer or time dynamics.
physical_contract.timestep: One layer segment per explanatory step.
checks: Reject ||o||<R; an origin on R directed inward has zero atmospheric traversal.
A downward ray stops at the first solid-planet boundary and never accumulates a far-side atmosphere segment.
Large finite tau retains -tau when exp(-tau) underflows to zero.
